step_description: Fix COM-1 by ensuring all modules (including nested example submodules) compile successfully.
prompt_text:
You are a remediation agent executing the next Hypergenium roadmap step for this repo.

Context (source of truth)
- Roadmap: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md (Rubric v0.1.0)
- Rubric: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
- Deterministic verifier: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- Current failing item to fix in this step: COM-1 (All modules compile)
  - Evidence: hgm-infra/evidence/COM-1-output.log

Goal
- Fix ONLY rubric item COM-1 by making the repo’s module compilation check pass.
- Specifically: the root module AND all nested Go modules under examples/**/go.mod must compile via the verifier’s compile_all_modules check.
- Refresh verifier evidence after the changes.

Strict guardrails
- Do NOT change any verifier scripts under hgm-infra/verifiers/.
- Do NOT change the rubric/roadmap docs under hgm-infra/planning/ as part of this remediation.
- Do NOT change .golangci.yml, .github/workflows/*, or any CI configuration in this step.
- Do NOT attempt to fix other failing rubric items (SEC-1, MAI-1, etc.). If they still fail after re-verification, only record that they remain failing.
- Do NOT modify the root module’s go.mod or go.sum in this step (repo root).
- Keep changes minimal and directly justified by the compile errors in COM-1-output.log.

Allowed write locations (explicitly allowed for this step)
- You MAY modify nested example module files under examples/**, including: 
  - examples/**/go.mod
  - examples/**/go.sum
  - examples/**.go files
  as needed to make those example modules compile (this is the scope of COM-1).
- You MUST write any new evidence/notes only under hgm-infra/ (prefer hgm-infra/evidence/).

Procedure
1) Reproduce the current COM-1 failure:
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm COM-1 is FAIL in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
   - Inspect: hgm-infra/evidence/COM-1-output.log
     Identify which example modules fail to compile and why.

2) Fix compilation for each failing example module (one module at a time):
   For each failing module directory that contains a go.mod (e.g., examples/event-adapters, examples/rate-limiting-limited, examples/websocket-demo):
   a) Re-run the failing compile command in that module to confirm the error:
      - cd <module-dir>
      - go test -run TestNonexistent -count=0 ./...

   b) If the failure is a missing go.sum entry for a dependency that the replaced root module imports:
      - Prefer the minimal fix first:
        - go mod download <module>@<version>
        (Example from COM-1 evidence: github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/feature/cloudfront/sign@v1.9.11)
      - If go test still fails with missing sums, then use the next minimal option:
        - go get <module>@<version>
      - Only if necessary, run:
        - go mod tidy
      Notes:
      - Avoid changing go.mod unless required; go.sum-only updates are preferred when they resolve the issue.
      - Do not run go mod tidy in the repo root.

   c) If the failure is a compile error in example source code (e.g., unused imports):
      - Make the minimal, semantics-preserving change so the example compiles.
      - Example class of fix: remove an unused import.
      - Do not refactor library code; keep changes confined to the example module.

   d) Re-run in the module:
      - go test -run TestNonexistent -count=0 ./...
      It must succeed for that module before moving on.

3) Re-run the full Hypergenium verifier to refresh evidence:
   - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh

4) Confirm COM-1 result:
   - In hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json, COM-1 must be PASS.
   - COM-1-output.log should show successful compilation for root module and all example modules.

5) Record progress (required):
   - Create/update: hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M2-COM-1.md
   - Include:
     - Date/time
     - The failing modules you fixed
     - The exact commands you ran in each module (especially go mod download / go get / go mod tidy)
     - Summary: COM-1 PASS/FAIL after final verifier run
     - If still failing, point to COM-1-output.log and summarize remaining errors

Deliverable summary to report back
- Confirm COM-1 is PASS (from hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json).
- Provide paths to refreshed evidence logs (do not paste large logs inline).

If you are blocked
- If you cannot download modules due to network or environment restrictions, do NOT hack around it by weakening checks.
- Capture the error output in COM-1-output.log via the verifier run and document the blocker in roadmap-progress-M2-COM-1.md.
guardrails: Fix only COM-1 (all modules compile); do not attempt other remediation in this step

Write new evidence/notes only under hgm-infra/
Example module changes are allowed only as needed to make example modules compile
